title: Repeated Missing Fabrics & Assets After Updates (Mac Issue)
content:
Hi CLO Team,

Since the CLO 2024 version, I’ve noticed that after every update, some of my favorite fabrics, topstitches, and normal maps disappear. Even the list of fabric physical properties becomes smaller. This just happened again after the latest update.

Interestingly, this only happens on my MacBook — on my iMac (2017) I still have _all_ the old fabrics and assets, including V1 and basic fabrics. My friend updated too and also lost her V1 and basic fabrics. This suggests the files might still exist, but CLO isn’t reading from the same library location after updates.

I really enjoy seeing the library grow, but it’s a bit frustrating to lose the older items we rely on. It would be wonderful if future updates could keep all previous assets while adding new ones — or at least give users an option to retain older libraries.

**Issue Summary:**

  * Missing fabrics, topstitches, and normal maps after every update since **CLO 2024**.

  * Fabric physical properties list is reduced.

  * Problem occurs **on MacBook** , but **iMac 2017 retains all assets**.

  * Friend updating also lost all **V1 and basic fabrics**.

  * Suggests files exist but **library path or update process prevents CLO from reading them**.

  * Request: Keep all previous assets intact while adding new ones in future updates.




Thanks so much for your hard work and for creating such a great tool — I truly appreciate the effort you put into supporting designers!

Best regards,

Vida

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Vida, thank you for your detailed feedback!All V1 fabrics in the library and in the physical properties were removed as the V2 fabrics have been and more accurate simulation. Some users did download a copy of the old V1 fabrics and put them all in a separate folder on their personal computers so they could continue to use them.
Reply 1: Hi Lucile,Thanks for your respond, I have also have done the same for myself, other file with different name. Just normal maps and top stitches are also less than old library which were useful.Again thank you for all effort that your team do and all of innovations.
content_description: Purpose: To report and seek a solution for missing fabrics and assets in CLO 2024 updates on MacBooks, while requesting that future updates preserve existing libraries alongside new additions.
